A.result: Book 1 RecordLifecycle and package root restored; Book2ClaimState has exactly nine ratified states.

B.result: CHAIN_SPECIFIC returns REQUIRES_CHAIN_CONTEXT without an invented duration and resolves only with matching deterministic chain context.

P4.result: CORROBORATED requires a corroborating claim, distinct source, distinct owner, distinct mechanism/provider, and rejects narrative copies.

authority.result: Numeric vN ordering is used; explicitly assigned overlapping candidates are rejected as ambiguous.

source_evidence.result: SourceEvidenceCoordinator validates evidence references before source locator/health versions; ResearchInterface routes through it.
